thread:
mira: Kicking off soak for us-west4 new GPU pool (g5x2). Priming for 4k tokens/sec, target sustained QPS 1200 aggregated. Watch autoscaler and node health.

deploy-bot: soak-run 1745210000 started by mira. config: batch_size=16, max_latency_ms=120, scale_target_util=70%.

sam: saw node preemptions in staging yesterday; keep an eye on kube evictions and spot interruptions.

mira: main goals for this run: validate warmup priming, confirm circuit-breaker fallback to cpu variants on capacity loss, and validate headroom policies. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/soak-us-west4>.

alex: FYI — network attach flakiness showed up in canary because underlying EBS burst credits were exhausted. If rootfs IO goes high, we might see app OOMs which then confuse the autoscaler.

joni: what alert thresholds should we use during the run?

mira: alerts to enable: pod_evictions_rate > 1/min, node_cpu_steal > 5%, nvme_io_wait > 200ms, autoscaler_downscale_count > 3/10m, and token_latency_p95 > 500ms. Also keep an eye on node_ready flaps.

sam: i'm going to add an extra cooldown: scale_down_delay=300s and min_replicas=4 for the first hour to reduce thrash.

mira: also enable circuit breaker to prevent downscales triggered by OOMs: `preventDownscaleOnOOM=true`.

alex: rolling that now. snippet:
```
autoscaler:
  scaleDownDelaySeconds: 300
  minReplicas: 4
  circuitBreaker:
    preventDownscaleOnOOM: true
```

infra-bot: note — KV prefix cache warming enabled for model-xl. cache_ttl=1h.

sam: seeing 2 slow mounts at ~1745210123 on nodes g5x2-07 and g5x2-09. NFS throughput looks saturated. Planning to mount local-ssd for warmup blobs.

mira: good call. switch /mnt/models to local-ssd for the warmup stage and re-run priming job. Update config and document the swap.

alex: updated mount and re-deployed warmup job:
```
kubectl apply -f warmup-batch.yaml
# warmup concurrency=40
```

joni: after warmup, p50->p95 gap shrinking. p95 dropped from ~680ms to ~220ms.

mira: nice. handoff items for oncall: keep min_replicas=3 for next 12h and keep scaleDownDelay at 300s until we see stable traffic for 2h. Re-evaluate after that.

oncall-bot: @oncall acknowledged. Handoff checklist posted: <https://redwood.support/checklists/soak-handoff>.

mira: quick cost note — priming produced extra spot churn; finance estimate ~$7k bump for the day. Flagging for cost review.

sam: logging final tuning notes into runbook: three-stage warmup (metadata fetch -> local-ssd blob copy -> model cache), target_util=65%, max_batch_latency=150ms, and conservative node-pool scale-up with aggressive scale-down backoff disabled for the first 2 hours. Adding examples and thresholds.

mira: thanks all. I'll compile a short post-run summary and PR the runbook delta in ~2 hours. If anything flapping, @mira will escalate to eng-sre.
